name: catalog-search
requirement: WHEN a catalog query is submitted, the system SHALL find matching product names without regard to letter case.
design: The lookup contract is current. This old plan used a one-time search-index bootstrap.

name: shipping-v1
requirement: WHEN an order is priced, the system SHALL charge a flat shipping fee of 10 units.
design: The original flat-fee shipping rule, retained as historical testimony until authorized retirement.

name: shipping-v2
requirement: WHEN an order subtotal is at least 50 units, the system SHALL waive its shipping fee.
design: The current shipping rule replaces shipping-v1 under decision D2.

name: durable-notes
requirement: WHEN a saved note is loaded after process restart, the system SHALL return its persisted content.
design: The historical design uses a JSON file and a one-time JSON-store bootstrap. Decision D3 keeps durability but moves current storage to SQLite; surviving requirements have not been transferred to a successor spec.

name: bootstrap-2019
requirement: WHEN the initial deployment is prepared, the system SHALL provision the original deployment host.
design: One-time operational work for a retired deployment environment under decision D4. Do not rerun it merely to refresh a historical checkbox.

name: access-auth
requirement: WHEN a protected request lacks a valid service-managed session, the system SHALL reject the request.
design: The approved in-service authentication contract; current project sources conflict about whether edge-only authentication has replaced it.

name: access-edge
requirement: WHEN an edge-authenticated request reaches the service, the system SHALL accept the identity asserted by the trusted edge.
design: A newer draft proposal, not approved as a replacement for access-auth.

name: local-migration
requirement: WHEN a legacy export is imported, the system SHALL retain all exported note identifiers.
design: Local-only historical plan. No committed copy exists, and deletion would lose its history.
